description: This file defines an Android activity named NoteEditActivity responsible for adding or editing notes. It interacts with user interface elements and communicates with NoteRepository for data operations.

classes.name: NoteEditActivity
classes.description: An activity for creating or editing notes, meaning it handles both new note creation and existing note updating based on intent data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initialization method that sets up the activity's layout, retrieves note data if editing, and registers button click handlers.
